sections.heading: Axis Colleges vs Dr. Gaur Hari Singhania Institute of Management and Research for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Axis Colleges if you want a 2020 flagship package record of ₹3 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹2.01 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kanpur.

Choose Dr. Gaur Hari Singhania Institute of Management and Research if you want a 2020 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and an admission route through ATMA, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Kanpur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Axis Colleges's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹3 LPA and a highest package of ₹13 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Dr. Gaur Hari Singhania Institute of Management and Research's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹13 LPA on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM Finance.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.
